newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 13.

text.p: All of Mexico's major ports were open Thursday as of 1000 local/1600 GMT, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Clear skies with strongest winds from northwest at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) affecting the states of Baja California, Sonora, Sinaloa and Nayarit and waves as high as three to five feet.

Light cold front heading southwest expected to bring lower temperatures and isolated rains to northwest Gulf of Mexico later today. Isolated showers and winds of 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 kilometers/11 to 22 miles per hour), causing wave heights between four and six feet, expected to reach coast of Tamaulipas state.

Wind gusts and rains headed to Central America coasts with scattered rains along the coast of Quintana Roo state. East and northeast winds at speeds of 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
